document: The counted-editions policy of this release (lead decision D3 of the adoption plan, 2026-11-14), frozen. analysis/source_quality.py reads `editions` as RULES_20261113_1113 and refuses this file when its digest differs from the one it pins; docs/evidence/2026-11-14/release-20261113-1113/policy.py rebuilds it from the rule and fails on any difference.

rule.universe: every marathon edition (city key and year) with at least one row in the adapted race_records.parquet
rule.counted: an edition supplies pooled pacing statistics (is counted) only when conditions 1 to 5 all hold
rule.1_split_tier: its split tier is `splits` (the producer sets `finish_time_only` when under half the rows have any intermediate split)
rule.2_tier: its verification tier is `stamped`, `stamped_weaker_source` or `partial` (never `held_for_review` or `unverified`; an `excluded` edition has no rows)
rule.3_coverage: it is stamped (`stamped` or `stamped_weaker_source`: the producer checked the release’s finishes against an independent official count, within 0.5%), or it is `partial` and the release’s rows with a finish time divided by its official finisher count lie between 0.95 and 1.05, both ends included
rule.4_screens: it passes the three timing screens of the October 16, 2026 review, computed on the adapted records by docs/evidence/2026-10-21/release-0829/screen.py and read as that file prints them (percentages to one or two decimals): (a) at least 5% of the rows with a finish time pass the timing checks (an edition with none fails); (b) not both: at least 75% of the quarter with the shortest finish times and under 50% of the quarter with the longest pass them; (c) under 25% of the complete grids put the finish at or before 40 km or run the last 2.195 km faster than 2:00 per km
rule.5_exceptions: it is not on the reviewed exception list (`reviewed_exceptions`): the decisions carried from the master-20261103b policy, and Honolulu 2021 to 2025
rule.category_order: an edition that is not counted takes one category and reason, the first that applies: a reviewed exception; finish_time_only (condition 1); held_for_review, then unverified (condition 2); partial_coverage (condition 3); invalid_split_grid (condition 4, screen a, then b, then c)
rule.order: the frozen list is sorted by city key, then year (Unicode code point order)
